title: New York Robotics Consortium Launches with 160 Startups
content:
# 纽约机器人联盟携160家初创公司正式启动

该消息发布之际，纽约州正努力在全球机器人竞赛中确立其重要竞争者的地位。

![高科技机器人正在装配线上工作](https://eu-images.contentstack.com/v3/assets/blt6b0f74e5591baa03/bltf7d067fcf2fa6d68/6980e0582e80c25cbe04996f/robot.jpg?width=1280&auto=webp&quality=80&format=jpg&disable=upscale)

旨在推动纽约大都会区机器人社区发展的非营利组织“纽约机器人”已正式启动。

该组织于上周启动，汇集了超过160家机器人初创公司，其目标是帮助巩固纽约在日益增长的机器人领域中的可行竞争者地位，以与波士顿、硅谷和慕尼黑等更成熟的中心竞争。全球精密齿轮和机械部件领导者SDP/SI也是其创始合作伙伴。

纽约机器人的启动恰逢其对AlleyCorp首届Deep Tech NY会议的赞助。纽约机器人表示，此举也将提升纽约州作为机器人创新与投资熔炉的地位。

纽约机器人成立于2024年，是一家非营利组织，旨在弥补其认定的一个长期存在的差距：尽管纽约具备成为机器人领域领导者的技术知识，但企业往往因组织孤岛而受阻。

纽约机器人表示，通过创建一个共享的生态系统，它希望消除这些障碍，并支持全州范围内的自动化应用。

作为创始合作伙伴，SDP/SI的角色将为初创公司提供所需的硬件、工程专业知识以及供应链可靠性，以帮助它们“从原型走向生产”。

纽约机器人执行董事Jacob Hennessey-Rubin在关于启动的[博客文章](https://nycrobotics.org/latest/news/new-york-robotics-formally-launches-amid-surge-in-robotics-investment-demand-and-talent)中表示：“我们的愿景是利用纽约在全球技术舞台上的中心地位，使其成为机器人创新的领先枢纽。通过快速扩展生态系统，并将机器人提升为华尔街一个严肃的投资类别，我们正在为纽约在这个变革性领域取得长期领导地位奠定基础。”

作为启动的一部分，纽约机器人还发布了NYR Index的私有测试版。这是一个专有平台，为合作伙伴提供对初创公司、投资者、实验室和企业参与者的数据、见解和映射的独家访问权限。

迄今为止，该组织还任命了几家创始成员，包括摩根大通、纽约大学、AlleyCorp、EisnerAmper和Cybernetix Ventures。

AlleyCorp的普通合伙人Abe Murray表示：“我们认为纽约对全球机器人社区至关重要，纽约机器人为加强该网络所做的工作对这座城市众多初创公司的未来增长和成功具有巨大影响。”

# New York Robotics Consortium Launches with 160 Startups
The news comes as the state works to place itself as a serious contender in the global robotics race.
[Scarlett Evans](https://aibusiness.com/author/scarlett-evans), Contributing Writer
February 2, 2026
2 Min Read
![High-tech robotics working on an assembly line ](https://eu-images.contentstack.com/v3/assets/blt6b0f74e5591baa03/bltf7d067fcf2fa6d68/6980e0582e80c25cbe04996f/robot.jpg?width=1280&auto=webp&quality=80&format=jpg&disable=upscale)
adventtr via Getty Image
New York Robotics, a non-profit organization set up to advance the robotics community in the New York metropolitan area, has officially launched.
Opening last week with more than 160 robotics startups, the group pitches itself as helping cement New York as a viable contender in the growing robotics space, ramping up to compete with more established hubs such as Boston, Silicon Valley and Munich. SDP/SI, a global leader in precision gears and mechanical components, is also a founding partner.
NYR's launch coincides with a sponsorship of AlleyCorp's inaugural Deep Tech NY conference, which NYR said also advances the state's standing as a melting pot for robotics innovation and investment.
Established as a non-profit in 2024, NYR was set up to improve what it identified as a long-standing gap: While the technological know-how for New York to emerge as a robotics leader is there, companies are often held back by organizational silos.
Related: [OpenMind Unveils Robot App Store](https://aibusiness.com/robotics/openmind-unveils-robot-app-store)
By creating a shared ecosystem, NYR said it hopes to remove these barriers and support automation uptake across the state.
SDP/SI's role as a founding partner will provide startups with access to hardware, engineering expertise, and supply-chain reliability needed to "move from prototype to production."
"Our vision is to leverage New York's centrality on the global technology stage to become a leading hub for robotics innovation," Jacob Hennessey-Rubin, executive director of NYR, said in a [blog post](https://nycrobotics.org/latest/news/new-york-robotics-formally-launches-amid-surge-in-robotics-investment-demand-and-talent) on the launch. "By rapidly expanding the ecosystem and elevating robotics as a serious investment class on Wall Street, we're positioning New York for long-term leadership in this transformative sector."
As part of the launch, NYR also released a private-beta version of the NYR Index, a proprietary platform that provides partners with exclusive access to data, insights and mapping across startups, investors, labs and enterprise participants.
To date, the group has also named several founding members including J.P. Morgan, New York University, AlleyCorp, EisnerAmper and Cybernetix Ventures.
"We see New York as essential to the global robotics community, and the work New York Robotics is doing to strengthen that network is hugely impactful to the future growth and success of so many startups here in the city," said Abe Murray, general partner at AlleyCorp.

title: ServiceNow and Anthropic Disclose AI Deal
content:
# ServiceNow 与 Anthropic 披露人工智能合作协议

通过此次合作，Anthropic 进一步深入企业人工智能市场。

![ServiceNow 在移动设备上的标志图片](https://eu-images.contentstack.com/v3/assets/blt6b0f74e5591baa03/bltf88ddd6d7f917822/697cc6a6822c19dae9c8889f/ServiceNow.jpg?width=1280&auto=webp&quality=80&format=jpg&disable=upscale)

盖蒂图片社

在与 OpenAI 达成协议一周后，ServiceNow 又与 Anthropic 签署了一项协议，将这家生成式人工智能供应商的 Claude 模型嵌入其跨行业（包括医疗保健和生命科学）的工作流程中。

根据 1 月 28 日披露的协议，[Claude](https://www.techtarget.com/healthtechanalytics/news/366637160/Claude-for-Healthcare-launches) 还将成为 [IT 服务供应商的人工智能智能体构建工具](https://aibusiness.com/agentic-ai/servicenow-unveils-ai-experience-agentic-features)——ServiceNow Build Agent 的默认模型。该工具使任何技能水平的开发人员都能创建和部署能够自主行动和推理的智能体工作流。

该协议还包括向 ServiceNow 的 29,000 名员工全面推广 Claude，并且 ServiceNow 将向工程师和技术团队提供 Anthropic 的人工智能驱动编码助手 [Claude Code](https://aibusiness.com/generative-ai/anthropic-out-with-claude-opus-4-5)。

ServiceNow 首席执行官 Bill McDermott 在一份新闻稿中表示：“ServiceNow 与 Anthropic 的合作正在通过为全球最大型企业提供人工智能原生工作流，将智能转化为行动。这种合作伙伴关系……将构建、部署和扩展关键任务应用程序的能力交到每个行业、每个层级的每个人手中。”

Anthropic 首席执行官 Dario Amodei 在新闻稿中表示，企业常常错误地将人工智能视为一个独立的工具，而不是将其嵌入日常工作中。随着各公司希望加快人工智能部署，这一点将变得越来越重要。

他说：“要获得更好的结果，方法是让人工智能成为你完成工作的一个组成部分——融入员工每天所做的全部工作范围中。”

这项协议是日益关注支持智能体人工智能和自主运营的一部分，紧随 ServiceNow 最近与 [Anthropic 的竞争对手 OpenAI 建立合作伙伴关系](https://aibusiness.com/generative-ai/openai-servicenow-enter-into-multiyear-partnership)之后。

在那项协议中，ServiceNow 将把 OpenAI 的 GPT-5.2 模型嵌入其平台，为 IT、人力资源和客户服务等职能的自主人工智能智能体提供支持。

此次合作也是 Anthropic 近期一系列协议中的一部分。随着其大语言模型应用范围的扩大，该公司最近还与 [全球保险公司安联](https://www.reinsurancene.ws/allianz-partners-with-anthropic-to-accelerate-adoption-of-responsible-ai/)、埃森哲、IBM、德勤和 Snowflake 达成了协议。

# ServiceNow and Anthropic Disclose AI Deal
With the partnership, Anthropic moves deeper into the enterprise AI market.
[Scarlett Evans](https://aibusiness.com/author/scarlett-evans), Contributing Writer
January 30, 2026
2 Min Read
![Pic of ServiceNow logo on mobile](https://eu-images.contentstack.com/v3/assets/blt6b0f74e5591baa03/bltf88ddd6d7f917822/697cc6a6822c19dae9c8889f/ServiceNow.jpg?width=1280&auto=webp&quality=80&format=jpg&disable=upscale)
Getty Images
A week after it forged a deal with OpenAI, ServiceNow entered into an agreement with Anthropic to embed the generative AI vendor's Claude models in its workflows across industries, including healthcare and life sciences.
Under the deal, revealed on Jan. 28, [Claude](https://www.techtarget.com/healthtechanalytics/news/366637160/Claude-for-Healthcare-launches) will also be he default model for the [IT service vendor's AI agent builder,](https://aibusiness.com/agentic-ai/servicenow-unveils-ai-experience-agentic-features) ServiceNow Build Agent, which enables developers of any skill level to create and deploy agentic workflows that can act and reason autonomously.
The deal also includes the rollout of Claude to ServiceNow’s workforce of 29,000 employees, and ServiceNow will provide Anthropic’s AI-powered coding assistant [Claude Code](https://aibusiness.com/generative-ai/anthropic-out-with-claude-opus-4-5) to engineers and technical teams.
“ServiceNow with Anthropic is turning intelligence into action through AI-native workflows for the world’s largest enterprises,” ServiceNow CEO Bill McDermott said in a release. This partnership … puts the power to build, deploy, and scale mission-critical applications into the hands of every person, in every industry, at every level.”
Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei said in the release that enterprises often make the mistake of treating AI as a standalone tool rather than embedding it into day-to-day work, something that will become increasingly important as companies look to ramp up AI deployments.
“The way to get much better results is to make AI an integral part of how you get work done -- woven into the whole range of things workers do every day,” he said.
The deal comes as part of a growing focus on supporting agentic AI and autonomous operations and follows ServiceNow’s recent [partnership with Anthropic rival OpenAI](https://aibusiness.com/generative-ai/openai-servicenow-enter-into-multiyear-partnership).
In that deal, ServiceNow will embed OpenAI’s GPT-5.2 model into its platform to power autonomous AI agents for functions such as IT, HR, and customer service.
The venture also joins a spate of deals for Anthropic, which recently forged agreements with [global insurer Allianz](https://www.reinsurancene.ws/allianz-partners-with-anthropic-to-accelerate-adoption-of-responsible-ai/), as well as Accenture, IBM, Deloitte, and Snowflake, as it expands the reach of its large language models.
